reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune. Imported from CCEH tune 001160 (the melody read from 001160a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, note for note); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. Lowell Mason's dates (1792–1872) are from our page for the tune BETHANY (content/hymns/tunes/bethany.json); CCEH's page gives none. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (001160a.nwc). The tune ends on F#, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
